_comment: Example field catalog for fetch_github.py --config. GitHub search rules: do NOT combine multiple topic: qualifiers with OR (422). Use ONE topic: per field, or free-text OR in name/description. min_stars filters noise; since_days = recency window. Copy this file and edit `fields`/`watchlist` to your own research interests.

fields.name: enzyme-biocatalysis
fields.query: biocatalysis OR "enzyme engineering" OR "enzyme cascade" in:name,description,readme

fields.name: kinetic-ode-fitting
fields.query: "kinetic modeling" OR "parameter estimation" OR "system identification" in:name,description
